title: Had sudden inspiration while commuting back from work having an energy drink and had this little idea which I can finally share.
author: BeingComfortablyDumb
selftext:
Hey Guys,

So the game is called "Weengz". It's about a tired office guy who drinks a 'mysterious can' and flies out the window instead of doing overtime. You tap to stay airborne, but every flap uses energy, so you’re collecting cans while dodging rooftops and whatever else gets in your way. It features:

\- Tap-to-fly controls with limited wing power and increasingly fast runs.

\- Chimneys, ducks, flying newspapers, and plastic bags that get stuck on your face.

\- Global leaderboards showing distance and revives used.

I've been a game designer and an amateur developer before AI came along. I already knew the pipelines and softwares involved in the process. AI just makes everything go so much faster. My niece helped build the core assets and sum up a design bible to follow. Once the planning and foundation was done which took about 2 days, It took about two more days to build, debug, test and deploy the game on both stores using Codex and Claude.

iOS version is still currently in review and facing some issues but it's now live on Play Store. Please check it out and let me know what you think!

 [Weengz on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mythicmotion.weengz)
